verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
You are the light, song of my life
You always lead me, You are the voice inside
You are my love, no one before You
All that I am points to You

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I was made by You
I was made for You
I am unfulfilled
Without full communion

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Since Your love got a hold of me
Since Your love got a hold of me
I’m a new creation
I’m forever changed

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
In You is all I need
You’re my breath, You’re my life
You’re my everything

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
In You I have my being
In You I have my being

verse.name: o2
verse.lines:
No one else can love You like I love You, Lord
For I was made unique in Your heart
I was made to bring You joy

verse.name: o3
verse.lines:
Now I have a purpose
Now I have a destiny
You made me for Your glory
You made me for Your glory
